brief: The SOX underperformed the S&P500 by 13% over the last 9 sessions, its worst stretch in 20+ years, amid an AI-driven de-grossing day; NDX lagged its equal-weight version by ~138bps, a bottom-5 day in 10+ years. US 10YR yields fell ~15bps, its largest one-day move since August 2025, as the AI selloff forces a growth reassessment; GS says equity weakness is easing the rates problem. GS Prime Brokerage shows Fundamental L/S, Systematics and Multi-Strats all down over 1%, the first time since Covid, and the HF Positioning Pair basket fell ~4.2%, its worst move since 2011 and down 10.4% MTD. The AI basket is down 23% from June highs; High Beta Momentum has erased its YTD gains; SPX ex-AI has outperformed by 6% MTD. Flows showed little rotation into defensives, with Asset Managers and Hedge Funds net sellers of large-cap tech and semis. Separately, GS Credit expects spreads to overshoot its prior downside-case peaks (93bp IG, 335bp HY) amid the AI financing wave, alongside record M&A debt issuance and rate-delayed PE sponsor exits. GS reiterates Nvidia Buy post-GTC Berlin, flags Spotify's Q3 subscriber/ad strength, and notes Deckers' sales miss despite a tariff-aided EPS beat and lowered HOKA/UGG guidance.
